name: Dead, Dead Or Deader

features.name: Positional wild multipliers
features.description: Wild values rise from 1x on the left reel upward.

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Stacked wilds on reels 2–4 that gain multipliers.

features.name: Dead and Deader Spins
features.description: Twelve free spins from three or four scatters.

review:
Dead, Dead Or Deader is a 5x3 slot where wild multipliers rise from left to right: the first reel's wilds are 1x, the next 2x and so on. Stacked xNudge Wilds appear on reels 2 to 4 and always nudge into view, adding to the multiplier with each step.

Scatters only land on reels 2 to 5. Three give twelve Dead Spins and four give twelve Deader Spins, where xNudge Wilds become more frequent. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 19,349x maximum.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
